# pulumi_discriminated_union_many

Generated Pulumi provider SDK for Dart.

## Installation

~~~sh
dart pub add pulumi_discriminated_union_many
~~~

## Usage

~~~dart
import 'package:pulumi_discriminated_union_many/pulumi_discriminated_union_many.dart' as provider;
~~~

## Alternative: Use directly from GitHub

~~~yaml
dependencies:
  pulumi_discriminated_union_many:
    git:
      url: https://github.com/kingwill101/pulumi-dart.git
      path: packages/discriminated-union-many
      ref: main
~~~

See the example/ directory for a runnable sample.

_This file is preserved across SDK regeneration done via task generate:<provider>._
